composition.serve_who: This sheet (SWS_108-1_AFT PLC.dwg, sheet 21/27, section AFT) is a WAGO PLC I/O detail page showing three 2-channel Digital Output modules (750-508, positions 13/14/15) hung off the AFT rack CPU 750-8213. Each module's two channels are individually labelled with the hydraulic-manifold EV pilot function it energises: DO-03 (POS.13) → transom door CLOSE/OPEN (EV 10.1A/B) → 260-transom-door; DO-04 (POS.14) → deck door OPEN/CLOSE (EV 10.2A/B) → 260-deck-door; DO-05 (POS.15) → mainsheet traveler TO PORT/TO STBD (EV 10.3A/B) → 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders (per engineer mapping 'mainsheet traveller -> 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders'). The rack layout itself (module positions, CPU, coupler) is infrastructure and attaches to the AFT PLC I/O Rack node.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Channels CH01/CH02 of DO module POS.13 (DO-03) are directly labelled 'transom door CLOSE (EV 10.1A)' and 'transom door OPEN (EV 10.1B)' — the drawn wiring runs straight from each channel terminal to the labelled function box and out to Connector Type I.

functions.label: Transom door hydraulic actuation command (CLOSE/OPEN)
functions.sheet_region: Left third of sheet, module POS.13 (columns 1-3, rows B-E)
functions.what_it_does: PLC digital outputs energise the transom door's hydraulic pilot valves to drive the door closed or open; each channel drives one direction only, with the opposite channel idle.
key_components: EV 10.1A pilot valve (transom door CLOSE direction)
EV 10.1B pilot valve (transom door OPEN direction)
Connector Type I (field wiring interface, see sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: Both DO-03 channels de-energised → no pilot energised → transom door holds last position (no motion command).
PLC → DO-03 CH01 (module POS.13, 750-508) energised → EV 10.1A pilot valve → hydraulic flow directs cylinder to CLOSE transom door → out through Connector Type I pin path (2/3 side) to field.
PLC → DO-03 CH02 (module POS.13, 750-508) energised → EV 10.1B pilot valve → hydraulic flow directs cylinder to OPEN transom door → out through Connector Type I pin path (1/4 side) to field.

functions.dry_data: Module 750-508, 2DO, CPU 750-8213, POS.13; channel output voltage measured relative to module's own common/M terminal (per-module common, WAGO 750-508); EV 10.1A/EV 10.1B are hydraulic-manifold pilot functions — pilot device type established on hydraulic sheet (PVED/PVEO per 260-transom-door actuation record: PVED ON/OFF).

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Channels CH01/CH02 of DO module POS.14 (DO-04) are directly labelled 'deck door OPEN (EV 10.2A)' and 'deck door CLOSE (EV 10.2B)', with wiring drawn to Connector Type I in the sheet's middle third.

functions.label: Deck door hydraulic actuation command (OPEN/CLOSE)
functions.sheet_region: Middle third of sheet, module POS.14 (columns 4-5, rows B-E)
functions.what_it_does: PLC digital outputs energise the deck door's hydraulic pilot valves to drive the door open or closed; each channel drives one direction only.
key_components: EV 10.2A pilot valve (deck door OPEN direction)
EV 10.2B pilot valve (deck door CLOSE direction)
Connector Type I (field wiring interface, see sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: Both DO-04 channels de-energised → no pilot energised → deck door holds last position.
PLC → DO-04 CH01 (module POS.14, 750-508) energised → EV 10.2A pilot valve → hydraulic flow directs cylinder to OPEN deck door → out through Connector Type I to field.
PLC → DO-04 CH02 (module POS.14, 750-508) energised → EV 10.2B pilot valve → hydraulic flow directs cylinder to CLOSE deck door → out through Connector Type I to field.

functions.dry_data: Module 750-508, 2DO, CPU 750-8213, POS.14; channel output voltage measured relative to module's own common/M terminal (per-module common, WAGO 750-508); EV 10.2A/EV 10.2B pilot device type established on hydraulic sheet — keep as named PVED/PVEO/pilot function, not downgraded to bare solenoid.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Channels CH01/CH02 of DO module POS.15 (DO-05) are labelled 'mainsheet traveler TO PORT (EV 10.3A)' and 'mainsheet traveler TO STBD (EV 10.3B)'; per engineer-confirmed mapping mainsheet traveller functions attach to 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders.

functions.label: Mainsheet traveler hydraulic actuation command (TO PORT/TO STBD)
functions.sheet_region: Right third of sheet, module POS.15 (columns 6-8, rows B-E)
functions.what_it_does: PLC digital outputs energise the mainsheet traveler's hydraulic pilot valves to slide the traveler car to port or to starboard; each channel drives one direction only.
key_components: EV 10.3A pilot valve (traveler TO PORT direction)
EV 10.3B pilot valve (traveler TO STBD direction)
Connector Type I (field wiring interface, see sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: Both DO-05 channels de-energised → no pilot energised → mainsheet traveler holds last position.
PLC → DO-05 CH01 (module POS.15, 750-508) energised → EV 10.3A pilot valve → hydraulic flow drives traveler cylinder TO PORT → out through Connector Type I to field.
PLC → DO-05 CH02 (module POS.15, 750-508) energised → EV 10.3B pilot valve → hydraulic flow drives traveler cylinder TO STBD → out through Connector Type I to field.

functions.dry_data: Module 750-508, 2DO, CPU 750-8213, POS.15; channel output voltage measured relative to module's own common/M terminal (per-module common, WAGO 750-508); EV 10.3A/EV 10.3B pilot device type established on hydraulic sheet (Cariboni cylinder circuit, PVED ON/OFF actuation per 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders record).

infrastructure.system_name: AFT PLC I/O Rack (WAGO) — DO module bank
facts: Three 2-channel digital output modules type 750-508 populate positions 13, 14, 15 of the AFT rack: 2DO POS.13 = DO-03; 2DO POS.14 = DO-04; 2DO POS.15 = DO-05

Each 750-508 module carries its own A1/A2 marking and a per-module common/reference (M) distinct from adjacent modules — meter probes for a channel's voltage go between that channel and the module's own M/common terminal
All three modules terminate to identical 4-pin 'Connector Type I' field connectors (pins 1-4), detailed further on sheet 4
This sheet is a module-detail page (positions 13-15 only); the full rack inventory/GA and position numbering is on the rack index page, not repeated here

discarded_as_clutter: Title block fields (JOB N°, CLIENT, PROJECT, SHEET, DATE, REV history, MYT-Systems address/contact) — administrative, not equipment data
DIN 34 copyright/rights notice text (vertical sidebar) — legal boilerplate
'2 DO MODULE (POS.13/14/15) 750-508 DO-0x' header lines at top — duplicate restatement of module identity already captured per-module in the detail blocks
Repeated '2DO' module type label appearing three times — same as TYPE/CPU/POS. block, not separate data
Repeated 'CONNECTOR TYPE I (see sheet 4)' caption x3 — same connector type restated per module, captured once in infrastructure
uncertainties: Connector Type I pin-to-terminal mapping (which of pins 1/2/3/4 correspond to +/- of each channel) is not detailed on this sheet — full pinout deferred to sheet 4, not read here.

Whether EV 10.1A/B, 10.2A/B, 10.3A/B are PVED or PVEO type pilot valves specifically (vs generic 'EV') is not restated on this sheet; type should be cross-checked against the hydraulic manifold sheet per established actuation records (transom door = PVED ON/OFF per prior extraction; deck door and mainsheet traveler pilot type not separately confirmed in established facts above, though 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders is recorded as PVED ON/OFF).
